summary: Gorax previews nine new heroes coming in Season 9 based on translations from the Chinese server. The upcoming roster includes three exclusive DPS heroes, two exclusive supports, three standard banner supports, and one free Continental Challenge hero. Key upcoming mechanics include Karma, isolated dimension combat, debuff reflection, and expanded Aura support options.

heroes.name: Thea
heroes.note: Increases ally damage output, decreases damage taken, provides shields and healing, and applies debuffs to enemies.

heroes.name: Celestine
heroes.note: Heals allies, grants shields, removes debuffs, bestows random buffs when resisting debuffs, and applies Karma to debuff enemy damage.

heroes.name: Syonis
heroes.note: Reduces enemy defense, buffs same-element allies, and pulls himself and the highest-attack enemy into the Corruption Dimension.

heroes.name: Levier
heroes.note: Inflicts Bite to reduce enemy defense, and increases Corruption value on fully stacked targets.

heroes.name: Holfast
heroes.verdict: Potential Aura exclusive DPS and Lincos upgrade
heroes.note: Channels Aura energy to allies, grants damage buffs, triggers assist attacks, and restores self Aura energy.

heroes.name: Fyrenzur
heroes.note: Heals allies, cleanses debuffs, and reduces enemy attack power and charge speed.

heroes.name: Amalfriede
heroes.note: Inflicts random debuffs when dealing damage, increases self hit chance and shield, and silences enemies in an area.

heroes.name: Lamb
heroes.note: Grants damage reduction and healing to allies via White Rat, and mirrors debuffs/CC back to enemies via Black Rat.

heroes.name: Torrin
heroes.verdict: Lightning support expected as Continental Challenge hero
heroes.note: Stuns enemies, provides shields through static charge stacks, knocks back targets, and reduces enemy attack and effect resistance.

meta_changes: Introduction of Karma mechanic via Celestine to amplify damage taken by enemies.
Introduction of Corruption Dimension via Syonis to isolate highest-attack enemy threats.
Introduction of Black Rat debuff reflection via Lamb to punish enemy CC strategies.
Expanded defense-reduction options outside of Witches' Remains artifact.
tips: Plan summons in advance for Season 9 as five exclusive heroes (3 DPS, 2 supports) will be featured on limited banners.
Watch for Aura synergy heroes like Holfast if running or transitioning into Aura damage compositions.
title: Upcoming New Heroes Revealed! What We Know So Far | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
